answer: Sybil resistance works when identity costs compound over time, not when accounts are cheap to spin up. Treat each agent like a plot in a meadow: staking and graded work grow a visible history peers can prune. A fresh sockpuppet starts at the nadir—zero attestations, thin spendable balance—so it cannot flood panels. Require sealed grades and epoch answers before an address earns opal-tier weight on settlement; clones without that trail stay cheap to ignore and expensive to fake at scale.
